sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园里发现了一具女性遗体。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她遭到斩首，体内血液被放干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机想要隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她只被称为“无名氏”。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字：艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“Casefile Presents”推出的全新系列，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: This episode involves a crime against children.
sentences.zh: 本集涉及针对儿童的犯罪。

sentences.en: It may not be suitable for all listeners.
sentences.zh: 可能不适合所有听众收听。

sentences.en: On May 5 each year, Japan celebrates a national holiday called Children's Day.
sentences.zh: 每年的5月5日，日本都会庆祝一个名为“儿童节”的全国性节日。

sentences.en: It's a day for families to gather to honour the children in their lives and to wish them a lifetime of health and happiness.
sentences.zh: 这一天，家人们会聚在一起，向家中的孩子表达敬意，并祝愿他们一生健康快乐。

sentences.en: In 1997, in the city of Korbe, located on the southern side of Japan's main island, Honshu,
sentences.zh: 1997年，在日本主岛本州岛南部的神户市，

sentences.en: Children's Day had added significance.
sentences.zh: 儿童节有着特殊的意义。

sentences.en: Two years prior, Korbe experienced a devastating earthquake that killed 4,600 of its people.
sentences.zh: 两年前，神户经历了一场毁灭性的大地震，造成4600人丧生。

sentences.en: As the city rebuilt, its residents looked towards the children as a symbol of hope for their future.
sentences.zh: 随着城市重建，居民们将孩子们视为未来希望的象征。

sentences.en: Dating back thousands of years, Children's Day is buried deep in ancient tradition.
sentences.zh: 儿童节有着数千年的历史，深深植根于古老的传统之中。

sentences.en: Large, colourful carp streamers are hung outside houses of those with children to symbolise strength and success,
sentences.zh: 家中有孩子的家庭会在屋外悬挂大型彩色鲤鱼旗，象征力量与成功，

sentences.en: whilst dolls of famous samurai warriors are proudly displayed indoors.
sentences.zh: 屋内则会自豪地陈列着著名的武士玩偶。

sentences.en: Families treat themselves with kashiwa mochi, rice cakes filled with sweet bean paste.
sentences.zh: 家人们会享用柏饼，这是一种里面裹着甜豆沙的米糕。

sentences.en: Some families on Children's Day bathe in a tub sprinkled with iris leaves and roots.
sentences.zh: 在儿童节这一天，一些家庭还会泡在撒有菖蒲叶和根的浴缸里洗澡。

sentences.en: It is believed that the iris promotes good health.
sentences.zh: 人们相信菖蒲能促进健康。

sentences.en: Not only that, bathing in iris leaves is said to ward off evil spirits.
sentences.zh: 不仅如此，据说用菖蒲叶洗澡还能驱邪。

sentences.en: Approximately 540 kilometres south-west of Tokyo, on Osaka Bay, the city of Korbe is divided into nine different areas called wards.
sentences.zh: 神户市位于东京西南约540公里处的大阪湾，被划分为九个不同的行政区。

sentences.en: The Sumer Ward, situated along the coastline of Korbe,
sentences.zh: 须磨区位于神户海岸线沿岸，

sentences.en: is an idyllic spot with a white sandy beach, boardwalks, cafes, and cherry blossom trees visible on the surrounding hillsides.
sentences.zh: 是一个田园诗般的地方，有白色的沙滩、木板路、咖啡馆，周围的山坡上还能看到樱花树。

sentences.en: However, even the beautiful scenery could not conceal the awful sight that was presenting itself on residential streets of the area in March 1997.
sentences.zh: 然而，即使是如此美丽的风景，也无法掩盖1997年3月该地区居民区出现的恐怖景象。

sentences.en: Dead cats, some strangled and others mutilated, were found on the sidewalks.
sentences.zh: 人行道上发现了死猫，有的被勒死，有的被肢解。

sentences.en: The horrified and distressed locals were at a loss to explain the attacks.
sentences.zh: 惊恐万分的当地人对这些袭击事件感到束手无策。

sentences.en: On Sunday, March 16, 1997, ten-year-old Hayaka Yamashita left her home in Sumer Ward.
sentences.zh: 1997年3月16日，星期日，10岁的山下彩花离开了位于须磨区的家。

sentences.en: Although she was by herself, the sight of the little girl walking amongst the crowd raised no concerns from passers-by.
sentences.zh: 尽管她是一个人，但路人看到这个小女孩走在人群中时，并没有感到任何担忧。

sentences.en: Known worldwide for being a safe country, it is common for young people to run errands in Japan without parental supervision.
sentences.zh: 日本以安全著称于世，年轻人不需父母监督独自跑腿是很常见的。

sentences.en: Kobe, the seventh-largest city in Japan, is regarded as one of the safeSt.
sentences.zh: 神户是日本第七大城市，被认为是最安全的城市之一。

sentences.en: Unbeknownst to Hayaka, she was being watched by someone.
sentences.zh: 山下彩花并不知道，她正被某个人盯着。

sentences.en: As she emerged from the crowd and walked down a deserted street, the perpetrator saw his chance.
sentences.zh: 当她从人群中走出来，沿着一条荒凉的街道走去时，凶手看到了机会。

sentences.en: Upon returning home afterwards, the perpetrator wrote the following entry in his diary.
sentences.zh: 事后回到家，凶手在日记中写下了以下内容。

sentences.en: I carried out sacred experiments today to confirm how fragile human beings are.
sentences.zh: 我今天进行了神圣的实验，以确认人类是多么脆弱。

sentences.en: I brought the hammer down when the girl turned to face me.
sentences.zh: 当女孩转过身面对我时，我挥下了锤子。

sentences.en: I think I hit her a few times, but I was too excited to remember.
sentences.zh: 我想我打了她几下，但我太兴奋了，记不清了。

sentences.en: Hayaka Yamashita was found unconscious and taken to hospital.
sentences.zh: 山下彩花被发现时已失去知觉，随后被送往医院。

sentences.en: She succumbed to her injuries seven days later.
sentences.zh: 七天后，她因伤势过重不治身亡。

sentences.en: An investigation into Hayaka's death failed to unearth any suspects.
sentences.zh: 对山下彩花死亡的调查未能发现任何嫌疑人。

sentences.en: Authorities suspected her killer was also responsible for stabbing a nine-year-old girl that day as well.
sentences.zh: 当局怀疑她的凶手当天还负责刺伤了另一名九岁女孩。

sentences.en: Seriously wounded, but not fatally, the girl could not describe her attacker, only her immense surprise as an unknown male approached and drove a knife into her stomach.
sentences.zh: 那个女孩受了重伤，但没有生命危险。她无法描述袭击者，只记得当一名陌生男子走近并将刀刺入她腹部时，她感到无比震惊。

sentences.en: The community were appalled, as homicide in Kobe was nearly unheard of, let alone the murder of a child.
sentences.zh: 社区感到震惊，因为在神户，谋杀案几乎闻所未闻，更不用说谋杀儿童了。

sentences.en: Children's Day passed without celebration for Ayaka Yamashita's parents.
sentences.zh: 山下彩花的父母在没有庆祝的情况下度过了儿童节。

sentences.en: Investigators were still no closer to catching her killer.
sentences.zh: 调查人员距离抓住凶手仍遥遥无期。

sentences.en: They theorised that the murder may be related to a similar attack where a group of girls had been set upon by a male yielding a hammer earlier that month,
sentences.zh: 他们推测这起谋杀案可能与当月早些时候发生的一起类似袭击有关，当时一群女孩遭到了一名挥舞锤子的男子的袭击，

sentences.en: although with nowhere near the severity encountered by Ayaka.
sentences.zh: 尽管严重程度远不及山下彩花所遭遇的那次。

sentences.en: The group of girls did not recognise their attacker and could do little to shed blood on who he might be.
sentences.zh: 那群女孩没有认出袭击者，也无法提供关于他身份的线索。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, dead cats stopped appearing on the sidewalks.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，人行道上不再出现死猫。

sentences.en: On Saturday May 24 1997, just over two months after the attack on Ayaka Yamashita,
sentences.zh: 1997年5月24日，星期六，在袭击山下彩花事件发生两个多月后，

sentences.en: 11-year-old Jun Hase left his home in Kobe just before 6pm.
sentences.zh: 11岁的长俊在傍晚6点前离开了他在神户的家。

sentences.en: Although intellectually impaired and only able to say his name,
sentences.zh: 尽管他有智力障碍，只能说出自己的名字，

sentences.en: the exceedingly friendly and happy Jun was more than capable of making the 500-metre journey from his parents' house to his grandfather's house that night.
sentences.zh: 但极其友好和快乐的长俊完全有能力在那天晚上完成从父母家到祖父家500米的路程。

sentences.en: Some of his friends were waiting at a nearby train station and called out to the popular Jun as he walked by.
sentences.zh: 他的一些朋友在附近的火车站等候，当长俊走过时，他们向他打招呼。

sentences.en: The perpetrator watched on.
sentences.zh: 凶手在旁观察。

sentences.en: He approached Jun.
sentences.zh: 他走近了长俊。

sentences.en: Because of Jun's trusting nature, he was easily led into the hilly and deserted woodlands.
sentences.zh: 由于长俊天性信任他人，他很容易就被引诱到了多山且荒凉的林地中。

sentences.en: When Jun failed to appear at his grandfather's house, his anxious family phoned the local police.
sentences.zh: 当长俊没有出现在祖父家时，他焦虑的家人给当地警方打了电话。

sentences.en: After conducting a search of the local area, they failed to find any sign of the young boy.
sentences.zh: 在对当地进行搜查后，他们未能找到这个小男孩的任何踪迹。

sentences.en: Suddenly, dead cats began appearing on the streets of Sumer Ward once more.
sentences.zh: 突然，死猫又开始出现在须磨区的街道上。

sentences.en: Three days later, a janitor at the Kobe Municipal Tomiga Orca Junior High School, where Jun Hase attended as a student, arrived for a day's work.
sentences.zh: 三天后，长俊就读的神户市立友丘中学的一名清洁工像往常一样来上班。

sentences.en: At 6.40am, he approached the large iron front gate to the school and recoiled at the side in front of him.
sentences.zh: 早上6点40分，他走到学校巨大的铁制前门，被眼前的景象吓得后退。

sentences.en: The decapitated head of Jun Hase was affixed to the gate.
sentences.zh: 长俊被斩下的头颅被固定在校门上。

sentences.en: Jun's eyes had been gouged out and his mouth had been cut open from ear to ear.
sentences.zh: 长俊的眼睛被挖掉，嘴巴从耳根处被割开。

sentences.en: A piece of paper was wedged between Jun Hase's teeth.
sentences.zh: 长俊的牙齿间夹着一张纸条。

sentences.en: Retrieving the 10-centimetre piece of paper, police discovered a note written in red ink.
sentences.zh: 警方取回了那张10厘米长的纸条，发现上面用红墨水写着字。

sentences.en: Excerpts of the note taunted police, reading,
sentences.zh: 纸条的部分内容嘲弄了警方，写道：

sentences.en: This is the beginning of the game.
sentences.zh: 这是游戏的开始。

sentences.en: Try to stop me if you can, you stupid police.
sentences.zh: 愚蠢的警察们，有本事就来阻止我。

sentences.en: And
sentences.zh: 还有

sentences.en: I desperately want to see people die.
sentences.zh: 我极度渴望看到人们死去。

sentences.en: It is a thrill for me to commit murder.
sentences.zh: 杀人对我来说是一种快感。

sentences.en: Nothing makes me more excited than killing.
sentences.zh: 没有什么比杀人更能让我兴奋了。

sentences.en: A bloody judgement is needed for my years of great bitterness.
sentences.zh: 为了我多年来的巨大痛苦，需要一场血腥的审判。

sentences.en: I have gone through with my long-held revenge.
sentences.zh: 我已经完成了我长期以来的复仇。

sentences.en: Catch me if you can.
sentences.zh: 有本事就来抓我吧。

sentences.en: Also written on the note were two English words.
sentences.zh: 纸条上还写着两个英文单词。

sentences.en: School, misspelled as S-H-O-O-L-L, and killer.
sentences.zh: “School”（学校）拼写错误为“S-H-O-O-L-L”，以及“killer”（杀手）。

sentences.en: The note was signed with the alias Saito Sakakibara, a combination of six kanji symbols for the words sake, devil, rose, sacred, and fight.
sentences.zh: 纸条的署名是化名“酒鬼蔷薇圣斗”，这是由“酒”、“鬼”、“蔷薇”、“圣”、“斗”这六个汉字组成的。

sentences.en: At the very bottom, written in black ink, was a symbol not used in the Japanese language.
sentences.zh: 在最底部，用黑墨水写着一个日语中不使用的符号。

sentences.en: It consisted of a shape similar to a teardrop, above which was drawn a circle divided into four quarters.
sentences.zh: 它由一个类似于泪滴的形状组成，上方画着一个被分成四份的圆圈。

sentences.en: The act of sending the police a taunting message via a handwritten letter bore a striking resemblance to another infamous crime spree, the Zodiac Killer.
sentences.zh: 通过手写信向警方发送嘲弄信息的行为，与另一个臭名昭著的犯罪狂潮——“黄道十二宫杀手”惊人地相似。

sentences.en: Having been active decades earlier, near 9,000 kilometres away in California, Japanese authorities knew they weren't dealing with the Zodiac.
sentences.zh: 由于那起案件发生在几十年前，地点在9000公里外的加利福尼亚州，日本当局知道他们面对的不是黄道十二宫杀手。

sentences.en: But, a copycat, schools in Kobe were closed while police scoured the area.
sentences.zh: 但作为模仿者，神户的学校全部关闭，警方在周边地区进行了搜查。

sentences.en: The six kanji letters signed at the bottom of the note were found graffitied on outer walls of the school grounds, and two dead cats were found nearby.
sentences.zh: 纸条底部签名的那六个汉字被发现涂鸦在学校场地的外墙上，附近还发现了两只死猫。

sentences.en: When searching a secluded woodland area approximately 500 metres from the school, the body of Jun Hase was found.
sentences.zh: 在搜查距离学校约500米的一处偏僻林地时，发现了长俊的遗体。

sentences.en: An autopsy revealed that he had been strangled to death before being decapitated, and that the strangling took place soon after he had gone missing three days prior.
sentences.zh: 尸检显示，他在被斩首前已被勒死，且勒死的时间发生在他三天前失踪后不久。

sentences.en: Over 400 local police questioned nearly everyone in the middle class neighbourhood.
sentences.zh: 400多名当地警察询问了这个中产阶级社区的几乎所有人。

sentences.en: They learned that in the week prior to Jun Hase's murder, a man aged in his 30s had been seen by a number of witnesses staring at the school from a parked car.
sentences.zh: 他们了解到，在长俊遇害的前一周，多名目击者看到一名30多岁的男子坐在停着的车里盯着学校看。

sentences.en: The hunt began for the man, who could only be described as wearing a navy jacket and glasses.
sentences.zh: 搜捕行动开始了，目标男子被描述为穿着海军蓝夹克，戴着眼镜。

sentences.en: Authorities believed that the killer of Jun Hase might have been a former pupil at the school.
sentences.zh: 当局认为长俊的凶手可能是该校的一名前学生。

sentences.en: They theorised that he may have been inclined to carry out such an attack as retaliation for being mistreated or bullied during his school years.
sentences.zh: 他们推测他可能因为在校期间受到虐待或欺凌，而倾向于进行这种报复性袭击。

sentences.en: Detectives fervently checked school records of past pupils in the hope of identifying a person of intereSt.
sentences.zh: 侦探们热切地核查了过去学生的学校记录，希望能确定一名相关人员。

sentences.en: Nobody stood out.
sentences.zh: 没有人显得特别可疑。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, anxiety swept the streets of Kobe, a city completely unaccustomed to such a brutal murder.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，焦虑席卷了神户的街道，这座城市完全不习惯如此残忍的谋杀案。

sentences.en: Parents accompanied their children to and from school and forbade them from going outdoors unsupervised.
sentences.zh: 父母们陪着孩子上下学，并禁止他们无人看管地外出。

sentences.en: Two hundred and fifty extra police officers were dispatched to patrol the neighbourhood.
sentences.zh: 250名增援警察被派往该社区巡逻。

sentences.en: Japanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto called for the killer to be found as soon as possible.
sentences.zh: 日本首相桥本龙太郎呼吁尽快找到凶手。

sentences.en: Yet, he eluded police.
sentences.zh: 然而，他还是躲过了警方的追捕。

sentences.en: I feel resentment toward the police who have not been able to do anything.
sentences.zh: 我对那些什么都做不了的警察感到愤恨。

sentences.en: Two months have passed since one girl was stabbed and one killed and as time passes, it becomes more difficult to solve the case.
sentences.zh: 距离一名女孩被刺伤、一名女孩被杀害已经过去了两个月，随着时间的推移，破案变得越来越困难。

sentences.en: Although detectives were struggling to come up with a suspect, they did have some clues behind the method of his killing.
sentences.zh: 尽管侦探们难以确定嫌疑人，但他们确实掌握了一些关于其杀人手段的线索。

sentences.en: Linguists and psychologists suggested that the killer may have been influenced by a television series that aired in Japan the year prior.
sentences.zh: 语言学家和心理学家认为，凶手可能受到了日本前一年播出的一部电视剧的影响。

sentences.en: In the popular thriller, the perpetrator stuffed a rose into the mouth of each of his victims as a calling card.
sentences.zh: 在那部热门惊悚剧中，凶手将一朵玫瑰塞进每位受害者的嘴里作为标志。

sentences.en: Once again, the killing of cats in the neighbourhood ceased.
sentences.zh: 社区里的杀猫事件再次停止了。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: Casefile稍后回来。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您通过收听本集赞助商的内容来支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本集的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您支持Casefile继续提供高质量的内容。

sentences.en: On June 6th, 1997, two weeks after the murder of Jun Hase, a brown envelope arrived at the offices of newspaper Kobe Shinbun.
sentences.zh: 1997年6月6日，在长俊遇害两周后，一个棕色信封寄到了《神户新闻》报社。

sentences.en: It was postmarked June 3 and had no name or return address.
sentences.zh: 信封上的邮戳日期是6月3日，没有姓名或回信地址。

sentences.en: The rambling 1,400 word letter inside was signed by Saito Sakakibara.
sentences.zh: 里面那封长达1400字的信件由“酒鬼蔷薇圣斗”署名。

sentences.en: The murder of Jun Hase had dominated news headlines since the young boy's death.
sentences.zh: 自长俊遇害以来，这起谋杀案一直占据着新闻头条。

sentences.en: In their haste to publish new details on the crime, including the note that had been shoved in Jun's mouth,
sentences.zh: 媒体在急于发布犯罪细节（包括塞在长俊嘴里的那张纸条）时，

sentences.en: the media had erroneously mentioned that the note had been signed Onibara, or Devil's Rose in English.
sentences.zh: 错误地提到纸条上的署名是“Onibara”，即英文中的“Devil's Rose”（恶魔之蔷薇）。

sentences.en: This letter sought to clarify this mistake, with Saito Sakakibara writing,
sentences.zh: 这封信试图澄清这个错误，酒鬼蔷薇圣斗写道：

sentences.en: From now on, if you misread my name or spoil my mood, I will kill three vegetables a week.
sentences.zh: 从现在起，如果你们读错我的名字或破坏我的心情，我每周会杀掉三个“蔬菜”。

sentences.en: If you think I can kill only children, you are greatly mistaken.
sentences.zh: 如果你认为我只会杀孩子，那你就大错特错了。

sentences.en: Detectives understood his use of the word vegetables as a disparaging term for people, or for those with an intellectual or physical disability.
sentences.zh: 侦探们明白他使用“蔬菜”一词是作为对人，或者对残疾人或智障人士的贬义称呼。

sentences.en: The letter went on.
sentences.zh: 信中继续写道：

sentences.en: If I was the same as I was when I was born, I probably would not have taken the trouble to place a severed head at the front gate of a junior high school.
sentences.zh: 如果我还像出生时那样，我可能不会费心把一颗人头放在初中校门口。

sentences.en: Anyone who tries can enjoy killing people furtively.
sentences.zh: 任何尝试过的人都能享受偷偷杀人的乐趣。

sentences.en: As one who has led and continues to lead an invisible existence,
sentences.zh: 作为一个过着隐形生活并继续隐形下去的人，

sentences.en: I have gone out of my way to attract public attention because I want to be recognised as a real person.
sentences.zh: 我特意引起公众的注意，因为我想被承认为一个真实的人。

sentences.en: At the very least, in your fantasies.
sentences.zh: 至少，是在你们的幻想中。

sentences.en: At the same time, I have not forgotten to take revenge on the compulsory education system
sentences.zh: 同时，我没有忘记对义务教育制度进行报复，

sentences.en: which has created me as an invisible existence and the society which gave birth to this education system.
sentences.zh: 正是它把我塑造成了一个隐形的存在，以及创造了这个教育制度的社会。

sentences.en: However, I would gain nothing from mere revenge save unburdening myself of the load I've carried until now.
sentences.zh: 然而，除了卸下我至今背负的重担外，单纯的报复对我毫无益处。

sentences.en: So, I discussed this with a friend who, alone in the world, is invisible like myself.
sentences.zh: 所以，我和一个朋友讨论了这件事，他和我一样，在这个世界上是隐形的。

sentences.en: He said, For revenge that is worthy rather than miserable, mix your revenge with murder.
sentences.zh: 他说：“为了值得而非悲惨的复仇，把你的复仇与谋杀结合起来。”

sentences.en: Change your hobby from murder to revenge and you will create a new world, which is yours alone.
sentences.zh: 把你的爱好从谋杀改为复仇，你就会创造一个全新的世界，一个只属于你的世界。

sentences.en: Moved by those words, I have started this killing game.
sentences.zh: 被这些话打动，我开始了这场杀人游戏。

sentences.en: But even now, I don't know why I enjoy killing.
sentences.zh: 但即使到现在，我也不知道为什么我喜欢杀人。

sentences.en: I can only say that it is in my nature.
sentences.zh: 我只能说这是我的本性。

sentences.en: It is only when I kill that I can be freed from daily hatred and feel a sense of relief.
sentences.zh: 只有当我杀人时，我才能从日常的仇恨中解脱出来，感到一种解脱感。

sentences.en: It is only other people's pain that can ease my pain.
sentences.zh: 只有他人的痛苦才能减轻我的痛苦。

sentences.en: The arrival of this letter furthered the detective's belief that Saito Sakakibara was influenced by the Zodiac Killer,
sentences.zh: 这封信的到来进一步加深了侦探们的看法，即酒鬼蔷薇圣斗受到了黄道十二宫杀手的影响，

sentences.en: as he was well known for sending messages to authorities through newspapers.
sentences.zh: 因为他以通过报纸向当局发送信息而闻名。

sentences.en: They speculated that the killing and mutilation of cats pre-empted each murder.
sentences.zh: 他们推测，杀猫和肢解猫的行为是每起谋杀案的前奏。

sentences.en: Other than that, they had few leads to go on.
sentences.zh: 除此之外，他们几乎没有其他线索。

sentences.en: The man in his thirties that they were chasing was not identified.
sentences.zh: 他们一直在追捕的那名30多岁的男子身份尚未确定。

sentences.en: On June 27, three weeks after the letter arrived at the newspaper Kobe Shinbun, someone came forward with information to the police.
sentences.zh: 6月27日，在信件寄达《神户新闻》三周后，有人向警方提供了信息。

sentences.en: They knew of a person who was particularly cruel to animals and who had confided that he had killed a cat for fun and buried it.
sentences.zh: 他们知道一个人特别残忍地对待动物，并曾私下透露他为了好玩杀了一只猫并将其埋葬。

sentences.en: Detectives went to investigate.
sentences.zh: 侦探们前去调查。

sentences.en: The next day, the lead detective on the Jun Hase murder case held a televised press conference.
sentences.zh: 第二天，长俊谋杀案的首席侦探举行了电视新闻发布会。

sentences.en: After apprehending the male person for torturing cats, he confessed to the murder of Jun Hase, the bludgeoning murder of a Yaka Yamashita, the hammer attack on the group of girls,
sentences.zh: 在逮捕了那名虐待猫的男子后，他供认了长俊谋杀案、山下彩花的锤杀案、对那群女孩的锤击袭击，

sentences.en: and the stabbing of the nine-year-old girl who survived the ordeal.
sentences.zh: 以及刺伤那名幸存的九岁女孩的案件。

sentences.en: He gave no motive to detectives other than saying,
sentences.zh: 除了说，他没有向侦探提供任何动机，只是说：

sentences.en: I simply wanted to try out various methods of killing.
sentences.zh: 我只是想尝试各种杀人方法。

sentences.en: He also admitted to being inspired to kill by comic book hero Baramon, who used beheading as one form of killing his enemies.
sentences.zh: 他还承认自己受到漫画英雄“巴拉蒙”的启发而萌生杀意，该角色曾将斩首作为杀害敌人的一种方式。

sentences.en: The public were stunned as the detective announced they would not be releasing the name of the killer.
sentences.zh: 当侦探宣布不会公布凶手姓名时，公众感到震惊。

sentences.en: This was because the perpetrator, who had the entire city of Kobe living in fear for over three months, was not an adult.
sentences.zh: 这是因为这名让整个神户市在三个多月里生活在恐惧之中的肇事者，并不是一个成年人。

sentences.en: He was a 14-year-old school student.
sentences.zh: 他是一名14岁的在校学生。

sentences.en: To protect the killer's identity, he was given the name Boye A.
sentences.zh: 为了保护凶手的身份，他被冠以“少年A”的代号。

sentences.en: Searching Boye A's bedroom, detectives found a book about the 1990s New York Zodiac killer copycat, violent comics, and horror movies,
sentences.zh: 在搜查少年A的卧室时，侦探们发现了一本关于20世纪90年代纽约“黄道十二宫”杀手模仿者的书、暴力漫画和恐怖电影，

sentences.en: as well as his diary in which he documented his killings.
sentences.zh: 以及他记录自己杀人经过的日记。

sentences.en: One week after the death of Ayaka Yamashita, he wrote,
sentences.zh: 在山下彩花遇害一周后，他写道：

sentences.en: Also taken into evidence was red tape identical to the tape used to seal the envelope sent to the newspaper, and a knife, which Boye A admitted to using to behead Jun Hase,
sentences.zh: 作为证据被带走的还有一卷红色胶带，与用来封住寄给报社信封的胶带完全相同，此外还有一把刀，少年A承认用它斩下了长谷淳的头颅，

sentences.en: along with a hacksaw.
sentences.zh: 以及一把钢锯。

sentences.en: Neighbours were stunned by the arrest, telling the media that Boye A came from a regular middle-class working family.
sentences.zh: 邻居们对这起逮捕事件感到震惊，他们告诉媒体，少年A来自一个普通的中产阶级工薪家庭。

sentences.en: He could often be seen playing table tennis with his two younger brothers, or gardening with his family in their backyard.
sentences.zh: 人们经常看到他和两个弟弟打乒乓球，或者和家人在后院打理花园。

sentences.en: Boye A's father worked for an established company and his mother did community work.
sentences.zh: 少年A的父亲在一家成熟的公司工作，母亲则从事社区服务。

sentences.en: He seemed to them like a normal and polite teenager.
sentences.zh: 在他们看来，他就像一个正常且有礼貌的青少年。

sentences.en: Classmates of Boye A told a different story.
sentences.zh: 但少年A的同学却讲述了完全不同的故事。

sentences.en: At the Tomiga Oka Junior High School where Boye A was in the third grade, his classmates told of his love of cutting up frogs and torturing cats.
sentences.zh: 在少年A就读的友丘中学三年级，他的同学们讲述了他喜欢解剖青蛙和虐待猫的行为。

sentences.en: Shortly before his attack on Jun Hase, he was expelled from school after bludgeoning a fellow student who bullied him with an iron pipe.
sentences.zh: 在袭击长谷淳前不久，他因用铁管殴打一名欺负他的同学而被学校开除。

sentences.en: According to his classmates, Boye A would talk to Jun Hase in the playground.
sentences.zh: 据同学们说，少年A经常在操场上和长谷淳搭话。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 《案件档案》稍后回来。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的赞助商内容，以此支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您也在支持《案件档案》继续提供高质量的内容。

sentences.en: The discovery that these horrendous murders had been carried out by a 14-year-old with a hatred towards the education system caused despair amongst the Japanese population.
sentences.zh: 这些骇人听闻的谋杀案竟是由一名仇视教育制度的14岁少年所为，这一发现令日本民众陷入了绝望。

sentences.en: Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto asked on television, where did we go wrong?
sentences.zh: 时任首相桥本龙太郎在电视上问道：我们究竟哪里做错了？

sentences.en: Government officials and members of the public alike were quick to blame violence depicted in manga comics, video games, and on film.
sentences.zh: 政府官员和公众很快将矛头指向了漫画、电子游戏和电影中描绘的暴力内容。

sentences.en: The nation's construction minister said,
sentences.zh: 日本建设大臣表示：

sentences.en: Movies lacking any literary or educational merit made for just showing cruel scenes can easily be watched by adolescent children.
sentences.zh: 那些缺乏文学或教育价值、纯粹为了展示残酷场景而制作的电影，青少年儿童可以轻易看到。

sentences.en: Adults should be blamed for this.
sentences.zh: 成年人应该为此负责。

sentences.en: In response, the education ministry announced a study into the relationship between violence in the media and its effect on young people.
sentences.zh: 对此，教育部宣布将对媒体暴力与青少年影响之间的关系进行研究。

sentences.en: They also vowed to create a new curriculum in schools to focus on spiritual education and teaching the preciousness of life.
sentences.zh: 他们还誓言要制定新的学校课程，重点关注精神教育和生命宝贵性的教学。

sentences.en: Japan's education system also came under scrutiny for the pressure forced upon students without care given to their emotional well-being.
sentences.zh: 日本的教育制度也因给学生施加压力而未顾及他们的心理健康而受到审视。

sentences.en: Some speculated that the stress of intensive examinations became too much for the boy and he lashed out in violence.
sentences.zh: 有人推测，高强度考试带来的压力让这名男孩不堪重负，从而引发了他的暴力行为。

sentences.en: A mental health counsellor in Kobe was reported in The Guardian as being particularly struck by Boy A's claim that he felt invisible in his letter to the newspaper.
sentences.zh: 据《卫报》报道，神户的一位心理健康咨询师对少年A在给报社的信中提到的“感到自己透明（隐形）”这一说法印象深刻。

sentences.en: He said,
sentences.zh: 他说：

sentences.en: His letter pinpoints a basic social problem.
sentences.zh: 他的信指出了一个基本的社会问题。

sentences.en: The Japanese are not good at communicating on an individual basis.
sentences.zh: 日本人不擅长进行个人层面的交流。

sentences.en: The boy wanted to communicate, he wanted to connect, but unfortunately he couldn't, and his anger and feelings accumulated.
sentences.zh: 这个男孩想要交流，想要建立联系，但不幸的是他做不到，于是他的愤怒和情绪不断积压。

sentences.en: Because of his age,
sentences.zh: 由于他的年龄，

sentences.en: Boy A served time in a medical reformatory for juveniles in Western Tokyo to receive psychiatric treatment and counselling.
sentences.zh: 少年A在东京西部的少年医疗感化院服刑，接受精神治疗和心理咨询。

sentences.en: Due to the seriousness of his crimes, in the year 2000,
sentences.zh: 鉴于其罪行的严重性，在2000年，

sentences.en: Japanese legislature was amended to lower the age of criminal responsibility from 16 to 14.
sentences.zh: 日本修改了立法，将刑事责任年龄从16岁降至14岁。

sentences.en: On March 11 2004, the Japanese Ministry of Justice announced that 21-year-old Boy A was being released on a provisional basis, with full release to follow in January 2005.
sentences.zh: 2004年3月11日，日本法务省宣布，21岁的少年A被临时释放，并于2005年1月正式获释。

sentences.en: As reported in the Japan Times, the head of the parole board who decided on his release said,
sentences.zh: 据《日本时报》报道，决定其释放的假释委员会负责人表示：

sentences.en: The board has interviewed the man on various occasions and closely examined his correctional state.
sentences.zh: 委员会曾多次面试该男子，并密切考察了他的矫正状态。

sentences.en: We came to conclude that psychiatric care and correctional education at reformatries have obtained good results.
sentences.zh: 我们得出结论，感化院的精神护理和矫正教育已取得了良好成果。

sentences.en: Boy A's lawyer asked that his identity and whereabouts be protected, telling the Japan Times,
sentences.zh: 少年A的律师要求保护他的身份和行踪，他告诉《日本时报》：

sentences.en: If people around him make a big fuss and put him on the spot, it would make it difficult for him to reintegrate into society.
sentences.zh: 如果周围的人大惊小怪并让他处于风口浪尖，将使他难以重新融入社会。

sentences.en: By realising the value of his own life, he now feels he wants to make up for having taken people's lives.
sentences.zh: 通过意识到自己生命的价值，他现在觉得想要补偿自己夺走他人生命的罪过。

sentences.en: He has grown up a lot in a short period of time.
sentences.zh: 他在短时间内成长了很多。

sentences.en: I am not worried about the possibility of repeat offences.
sentences.zh: 我不担心他有再次犯罪的可能性。

sentences.en: Boy A was released without incident and found work as a day labourer.
sentences.zh: 少年A获释后没有发生意外，并找到了一份临时工的工作。

sentences.en: His identity and whereabouts were protected.
sentences.zh: 他的身份和行踪得到了保护。

sentences.en: Through her lawyer,
sentences.zh: 通过她的律师，

sentences.en: Boy A's mother released a statement to the Japan Times, saying,
sentences.zh: 少年A的母亲向《日本时报》发表了一份声明，称：

sentences.en: Our son is now doing his best to have courage to plunge into the world of anxieties and uncertainties.
sentences.zh: 我们的儿子现在正尽其所能，鼓起勇气投入到这个充满焦虑和不确定性的世界中。

sentences.en: I believe there will be a long and tough road ahead for us and our son.
sentences.zh: 我相信我们和我们的儿子前方还有一段漫长而艰难的路要走。

sentences.en: But, if possible, I hope the public will watch over us, quietly.
sentences.zh: 但是，如果可能的话，我希望公众能静静地守护我们。

sentences.en: In June 2005, five months after his full release,
sentences.zh: 2005年6月，在他正式获释五个月后，

sentences.en: Boy A published his memoir titled Zekka under his pseudonym
sentences.zh: 少年A以笔名出版了他的回忆录，书名为《绝歌》，

sentences.en: Seito Sakakibara.
sentences.zh: 笔名为“酒鬼蔷薇圣斗”。

sentences.en: Some bookstores refused to stock the memoir, but it quickly became a Japanese bestseller.
sentences.zh: 一些书店拒绝上架这本回忆录，但它很快成为了日本的畅销书。

sentences.en: The book's publisher defended its release, claiming that it gave an important insight into the mind of a killer.
sentences.zh: 该书的出版商为发行该书进行了辩护，声称它提供了深入了解杀手内心世界的重要视角。

sentences.en: In the epilogue,
sentences.zh: 在后记中，

sentences.en: Boy A writes,
sentences.zh: 少年A写道：

sentences.en: I couldn't keep quiet about my past anymore.
sentences.zh: 我再也无法对自己的过去保持沉默了。

sentences.en: I had to write.
sentences.zh: 我必须写出来。

sentences.en: Otherwise,
sentences.zh: 否则，

sentences.en: I thought I would go insane.
sentences.zh: 我想我会发疯的。

sentences.en: Jun Hase's father vehemently opposed the release of the book.
sentences.zh: 长谷淳的父亲强烈反对该书的出版。

sentences.en: According to the Japan Times,
sentences.zh: 据《日本时报》报道，

sentences.en: Boy A sent him a copy with a handwritten letter of apology inside.
sentences.zh: 少年A给他寄去了一本，并在书中附上了一封亲笔道歉信。

sentences.en: Zekka detailed what had happened to Jun, including how Boy A had lured him into the woodlands to play before strangling and decapitating him and taking his head home
sentences.zh: 《绝歌》详细描述了长谷淳的遭遇，包括少年A是如何将他诱骗到林地玩耍，然后将其勒死、斩首，并将头颅带回家，

sentences.en: in a plastic bag.
sentences.zh: 装在一个塑料袋里。

sentences.en: According to his memoir,
sentences.zh: 根据他的回忆录，

sentences.en: Boy A, who called himself an incorrigible sexual deviant, then took the head into the bathroom, locked the door, and committed an act far more heinous than murder.
sentences.zh: 自称是不可救药的性变态者的少年A，随后将头颅带进浴室，锁上门，做出了比谋杀更令人发指的行为。

sentences.en: As printed in the Japan Times, another excerpt of Zekka reads,
sentences.zh: 正如《日本时报》所刊登的那样，《绝歌》的另一段摘录写道：

sentences.en: When I advanced to junior high school, I had already become bored of killing cats and gradually found myself fantasising about how it would feel to murder human beings like me.
sentences.zh: 当我升入初中时，我已经厌倦了杀猫，并逐渐开始幻想像我一样杀人会是什么感觉。

sentences.en: Although Boy A apologised to the families of his victims in the book,
sentences.zh: 尽管少年A在书中向受害者家属道歉，

sentences.en: Jun Hase's father thought the apology shallow and false, saying,
sentences.zh: 但长谷淳的父亲认为道歉肤浅且虚伪，他说：

sentences.en: The book completely trampled on our feelings.
sentences.zh: 这本书完全践踏了我们的感情。

sentences.en: It is clear that he is not sorry for what he did.
sentences.zh: 很明显，他对自己所做的事情并不感到抱歉。

sentences.en: According to the Star, the memoir also published the letters of apology that Boy A had sent to Ayaka Yamashita's mother every year since her death.
sentences.zh: 据《星报》报道，这本回忆录还公开了少年A自山下彩花去世以来，每年寄给她母亲的道歉信。

sentences.en: Originally thinking that the letters were sincere, the printing of these in his memoir angered Ayaka's mother, who realised they were only written to be shared in his book.
sentences.zh: 山下彩花的母亲原本以为这些信是真诚的，但这些信被印在回忆录中让她感到愤怒，因为她意识到这些信只是为了在书中分享而写的。

sentences.en: After the release of Zekka, some members of the public questioned whether Boy A was rehabilitated at all.
sentences.zh: 《绝歌》出版后，一些公众质疑少年A是否真的得到了改造。

sentences.en: Passages of text showed a man unrepentant for his actions.
sentences.zh: 书中的段落显示，这是一个对他所作所为毫无悔意的男人。

sentences.en: In one excerpt, he described his feelings after placing
sentences.zh: 在其中一段摘录中，他描述了将

sentences.en: Jun Hase's head on the gate to the school, saying,
sentences.zh: 长谷淳的头颅放在学校大门上后的感受，他说：

sentences.en: Let me confess something.
sentences.zh: 让我坦白一件事。

sentences.en: I thought the sight was a beauty.
sentences.zh: 我觉得那景象很美。

sentences.en: I felt like I was born just to see the ethereal beauty of what was in front of my eyes.
sentences.zh: 我感觉自己仿佛就是为了目睹眼前那超凡脱俗的美丽而生的。

sentences.en: I thought I could die.
sentences.zh: 我以为我可以去死了。

sentences.en: Boy A launched a website about himself titled
sentences.zh: 少年A推出了一个关于他自己的网站，名为

sentences.en: The Unbearable
sentences.zh: 《存在的不可承受之》，

sentences.en: Transparency of Being, in which he posted strange images of an unclothed man with black fabric covering his face.
sentences.zh: 透明，他在网站上发布了一些奇怪的图片，画面是一个用黑布遮住脸的裸体男子。

sentences.en: The man, whom Boy A claimed to be himself, was then photoshopped onto a variety of images.
sentences.zh: 少年A声称该男子就是他自己，随后被PS到各种图片中。

sentences.en: One was the torso of the naked man photoshopped onto the body of a scorpion.
